items.contentSnippet: OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.

summaries.zh: OpenAI承诺与美能源部及国家实验室合作，利用前沿AI加速科学发现，推动美国科学发展。
summaries.en: OpenAI has announced its commitment to advancing American science by collaborating with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs. The partnership aims to leverage frontier AI technologies to accelerate scientific discovery. The initiative highlights a strategic effort to integrate cutting-edge AI into research, enhancing innovation and progress in the field.

items.summary: OpenAI承诺与美能源部及国家实验室合作，利用前沿AI加速科学发现，推动美国科学发展。

items.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
items.content: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.
items.contentSnippet: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.

summaries.zh: OpenAI推出企业级AI代理平台OpenAI Presence，旨在帮助组织部署可信的语音和聊天代理，以优化客户和内部工作流程。该平台已验证其有效性，为企业提供了高效、可靠的AI解决方案。
summaries.en: OpenAI Presence is an enterprise AI agent platform designed to assist organizations in deploying trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows. The platform offers a proven solution for integrating AI-powered agents into various operational processes.

items.summary: OpenAI推出企业级AI代理平台OpenAI Presence，旨在帮助组织部署可信的语音和聊天代理，以优化客户和内部工作流程。该平台已验证其有效性，为企业提供了高效、可靠的AI解决方案。

items.title: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
items.content: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.
items.contentSnippet: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.

summaries.zh: NTT DATA集团通过使用ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex，帮助9000名员工实现工作自动化，将事件分析时间缩短至30分钟，并扩大安全AI的采用规模。
summaries.en: NTT DATA Group employs ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to automate work for 9,000 employees, reducing incident analysis time to 30 minutes. The solution facilitates scalable secure AI adoption across the organization.

items.summary: NTT DATA集团通过使用ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex，帮助9000名员工实现工作自动化，将事件分析时间缩短至30分钟，并扩大安全AI的采用规模。

items.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program
items.content: OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.

summaries.zh: OpenAI推出面向小企业的ChatGPT项目，旨在帮助创业者提升AI技能，通过ChatGPT Work实现工作自动化，助力企业发展。该项目为小企业提供了实用的AI工具和资源，促进业务增长。
summaries.en: OpenAI introduces the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program to assist entrepreneurs in developing AI skills, automating tasks, and leveraging ChatGPT Work for business growth. The initiative aims to provide small business owners with tools to enhance productivity and innovation.

items.summary: OpenAI推出面向小企业的ChatGPT项目，旨在帮助创业者提升AI技能，通过ChatGPT Work实现工作自动化，助力企业发展。该项目为小企业提供了实用的AI工具和资源，促进业务增长。

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation
items.content: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.

summaries.zh: OpenAI和Hugging Face就AI模型评估期间发生的安全事件分享了早期发现，指出高级网络能力并为防御者提供经验教训。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, revealing advanced cyber capabilities and providing insights for defense strategies. The collaboration aimed to address the incident and share key learnings with the industry.

items.summary: OpenAI和Hugging Face就AI模型评估期间发生的安全事件分享了早期发现，指出高级网络能力并为防御者提供经验教训。
